segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: How do you come to the university each day? Train or bus or do you have a car?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Oh, I always walk — I haven’t got a car and anyway I live quite close.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Do you know anything about parking rights on the campus? I was wondering whether students are allowed to park their cars on the campus or not?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, I think it’s possible for post graduate students but not for undergraduate students.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: That doesn’t seem very fair.

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: No, I suppose not, but there simply isn’t enough room on the campus for everyone to park.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Do you need a parking permit?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yeah, I believe you do.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Where do I get that from?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: I think you can get a parking sticker from the administration office.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Where’s that?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: It’s in the building called Block G. Right next to Block E.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Block G?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yeah.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Oh right. And what happens to you if you don’t buy a sticker? Do they clamp your wheels or give you a fine?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: No, I think they tow your car away.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Oh really?

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yeah. And then they fine you as well because you have to pay to get the car back.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: I’d better get the sticker then.

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yeah.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Where exactly is the administration office again? I’m new to this university and I’m still trying to find my way around.

segments.speaker: FEMALE STUDENT
segments.en: Right. You go along Library Road, past the tennis courts on your left and the swimming pool on your right and the administration office is opposite the car park on the left. You can’t miss it.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: So it’s up Library Road, past the swimming pool, opposite the car park. Right, I’ll go straight over there. Bye and thanks for the help.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Good morning, can I help you?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, I was told to come over here to get a parking sticker. Is this the right place?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Yes, it is. Are you a post graduate student?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Yes, I am.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: OK, well, I’ll just need to take some details ... Your name?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Richard Lee — that’s spelt L double E.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Richard ... Lee. And the address?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Flat 13, 30 Enmore Road

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: How do you spell Enmore?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: E-N-M-0-R-E. And that’s in the suburb of Newport: N-E-W-P-0-R-T.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Faculty?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: I beg your pardon?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Which faculty are you in?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Architecture, the Faculty of Architecture.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Right ... and the registration number of your car?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Let me see um L X J five oh ... No, sorry, I always get that wrong, it’s LJX 058K.

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: LJX 508K.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: No … 058K

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Ah. And what make is the car?

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: It s a Ford

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: A Ford. Fine! Well, I’ll just get you to sign here and when you’ve paid the cashier I’ll be able to issue you with the sticker.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Right. Where do I pay?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: Just across the corridor in the cashier’s office. Oh, but it’s 12.30 now and they close at 12.15 for lunch. But they open again at a quarter past two until 4.30

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Oh .. they’re not open till quarter past two?

segments.speaker: CLERK
segments.en: No. When you get your sticker, you must attach it to the front windscreen of your car. I m afraid it’s not valid if you don’t have it stuck on the window.

segments.speaker: MALE STUDENT
segments.en: Right, I see. Thanks very much I’ll just wait here then.
